lines.title: Information Security Strategy
lines.testFocus: A documented strategy exists, is approved at executive level and is aligned to entity objectives.

lines.title: Information Security Governance and Roles
lines.testFocus: A governance body meets, security roles are formally assigned and authority is clear.

lines.title: Information Security Programme and Plan
lines.testFocus: A costed, dated implementation plan exists and progress against it is reported.

lines.title: Resourcing and Budget
lines.testFocus: Budget and people are allocated to the programme and are sufficient for the priority level claimed.

lines.title: Risk Management Framework
lines.testFocus: A documented framework defines method, scale, criteria, roles and frequency.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Enterprise Risk Register

lines.title: Risk Assessment
lines.testFocus: Assessments are performed for assets in scope, are current, and cover threats and vulnerabilities.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Enterprise Risk Register

lines.title: Risk Treatment and Acceptance
lines.testFocus: Treatment plans have owners and dates; residual risk is formally accepted by the risk owner.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Enterprise Risk Register

lines.title: Risk Monitoring and Review
lines.testFocus: Risks are reviewed at defined intervals and after significant change; the register is live, not annual.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Enterprise Risk Register

lines.title: Awareness Programme
lines.testFocus: A programme exists, reaches all staff and contractors, and is refreshed.

lines.title: Role-based Training
lines.testFocus: Staff in security-relevant roles receive training specific to those roles; records are retained.

lines.title: Effectiveness Measurement
lines.testFocus: Awareness effectiveness is measured, not just attendance - testing, phishing simulation, incident trend.

lines.title: Prior to Employment
lines.testFocus: Screening proportionate to the role and to the classification of information handled.

lines.title: During Employment
lines.testFocus: Terms of employment carry security obligations; a disciplinary process exists and is used.

lines.title: Termination or Change of Employment
lines.testFocus: Access revoked, assets returned, obligations that survive employment are communicated.

lines.title: Legal, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
lines.testFocus: Applicable UAE law, regulator direction and contract terms are identified and tracked.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Privacy (ROPA, DPIA) · Legal register

lines.title: Compliance with Security Policies and Standards
lines.testFocus: Technical and procedural compliance is checked, not assumed; deviations are recorded.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Privacy (ROPA, DPIA) · Legal register

lines.title: Information Systems Audit Considerations
lines.testFocus: Audit activity on live systems is planned and controlled so it does not disrupt the service.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Privacy (ROPA, DPIA) · Legal register

lines.title: Protection of Records and Privacy
lines.testFocus: Records are protected against loss and falsification; personal data handled per applicable law.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Privacy (ROPA, DPIA) · Legal register

lines.title: Monitoring and Measurement
lines.testFocus: Security performance indicators are defined, collected and reported to management.
lines.evidenceLives: Audit module · CAPA tracker · Management review

lines.title: Internal Audit
lines.testFocus: An internal audit programme covers the IA controls and auditors are independent of what they audit.
lines.evidenceLives: Audit module · CAPA tracker · Management review

lines.title: Management Review
lines.testFocus: Executive review at planned intervals with defined inputs and recorded decisions.
lines.evidenceLives: Audit module · CAPA tracker · Management review

lines.title: Corrective Action and Continual Improvement
lines.testFocus: Nonconformities are recorded, root cause established, actions tracked to verified closure.
lines.evidenceLives: Audit module · CAPA tracker · Management review

lines.title: Inventory and Ownership of Assets
lines.testFocus: A current inventory of information assets with a named owner for each.

lines.title: Acceptable Use
lines.testFocus: Rules for acceptable use are documented, communicated and acknowledged.

lines.title: Information Classification and Labelling
lines.testFocus: A classification scheme is applied and labelling is visible in practice, not only in policy.

lines.title: Media Handling and Disposal
lines.testFocus: Removable media is controlled, transported securely and disposed of so data cannot be recovered.

lines.title: Secure Areas and Physical Entry
lines.testFocus: Perimeters defined, entry controlled and logged, visitors escorted.

lines.title: Equipment Security and Siting
lines.testFocus: Equipment is sited and protected against unauthorised access and environmental hazard.

lines.title: Supporting Utilities and Environmental Threats
lines.testFocus: Power, cooling and fire protection are adequate, maintained and tested.

lines.title: Secure Disposal and Off-premises Assets
lines.testFocus: Assets leaving the premises are authorised and protected; disposal is certified.

lines.title: Operational Procedures and Responsibilities
lines.testFocus: Documented operating procedures exist, are current, and segregation of duties is applied.

lines.title: Change and Capacity Management
lines.testFocus: Changes are assessed, approved and recorded; capacity is monitored against requirement.

lines.title: Protection from Malicious Code
lines.testFocus: Anti-malware is deployed, current across the estate, and exceptions are known.

lines.title: Backup
lines.testFocus: Backups are taken per policy, protected, and - the point most audits fail - restore-tested.

lines.title: Logging and Monitoring
lines.testFocus: Security events are logged, logs are protected from alteration, and someone actually reviews them.

lines.title: Technical Vulnerability Management
lines.testFocus: Vulnerabilities are identified, risk-rated and remediated within defined timescales.

lines.title: Network Security Management
lines.testFocus: Networks are managed and controlled; security features of network services are defined.

lines.title: Information Transfer and Exchange
lines.testFocus: Transfer of information inside and outside the entity is governed by policy and agreement.

lines.title: Electronic Messaging and Public Services
lines.testFocus: Messaging and publicly available information are protected against interception and alteration.

lines.title: Access Control Policy
lines.testFocus: A policy exists based on business and security requirements, and reflects least privilege.

lines.title: User Access Management and Privileged Access
lines.testFocus: Provisioning, review and revocation are controlled; privileged accounts are restricted and reviewed.

lines.title: User Responsibilities and Authentication
lines.testFocus: Authentication is adequate for the classification; users understand their obligations.

lines.title: Network Access Control
lines.testFocus: Access to networks and network services is authorised and enforced.

lines.title: Operating System and Application Access Control
lines.testFocus: Access at OS and application layer is restricted, and utility programs are controlled.

lines.title: Mobile Computing and Teleworking
lines.testFocus: Mobile devices and remote working are governed by policy and technical control.

lines.title: Third-Party Risk Identification and Agreements
lines.testFocus: Risks from third-party access are assessed and security terms are in the agreement.

lines.title: Third-Party Service Delivery Monitoring
lines.testFocus: Delivery, reports and records from third parties are monitored and reviewed.

lines.title: Managing Changes to Third-Party Services
lines.testFocus: Changes to third-party services are managed with regard to the criticality of what they support.

lines.section: T7 Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
lines.title: Security Requirements of Information Systems
lines.testFocus: Security requirements are stated in the specification before build or purchase.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Project and development records

lines.section: T7 Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
lines.title: Correct Processing in Applications
lines.testFocus: Input, processing and output validation prevent corruption and misuse.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Project and development records

lines.section: T7 Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
lines.title: Cryptographic Controls
lines.testFocus: A policy on cryptography exists and key management is defined and practised.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Project and development records

lines.section: T7 Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
lines.title: Security of System Files and Test Data
lines.testFocus: Operational software is controlled; test data is selected and protected, not live data by default.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Project and development records

lines.section: T7 Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance
lines.title: Security in Development and Support Processes
lines.testFocus: Secure development, change control within development, and outsourced development oversight.
lines.evidenceLives: Gap Assessment · Project and development records

lines.title: Reporting Events and Weaknesses
lines.testFocus: Staff know how to report, and do report; the channel is available and used.

lines.title: Incident Response and Management
lines.testFocus: Responsibilities and procedures exist; incidents are classified, escalated and resolved.

lines.title: Learning, Evidence Collection and Improvement
lines.testFocus: Evidence is collected in a way that would stand up; lessons change the controls.

lines.title: Continuity Planning and Business Impact Analysis
lines.testFocus: BIA identifies critical services and recovery objectives; security is part of the continuity plan.
lines.evidenceLives: BCMS including BIA · Continuity test records

lines.title: Implementing Continuity for Information Security
lines.testFocus: Controls remain effective during disruption, or compensating controls are defined.
lines.evidenceLives: BCMS including BIA · Continuity test records

lines.title: Testing, Maintenance and Review
lines.testFocus: Plans are tested at planned intervals, results recorded and plans updated.
lines.evidenceLives: BCMS including BIA · Continuity test records
